g.text: Where the Two Linear Transport Contributions Occur
5N | Warm-layer vertical integrals | Same color scale within each row
Positive northward. Each longitude is vertically integrated through the monthly climatological sigma=26 warm layer.
Different color ranges between rows reflect their different magnitudes; 2016 and 2024 share the same range within each row.
